text: The authors compare judges who read arguments for both answer options (Passage+Snippet+Argument, PSA) with judges who do not (Passage+Snippet, PS). They omit a no-snippet condition because Parrish et al. (2022) had already shown that snippets increase human accuracy on this task.
title: PSA vs PS conditions: judging with and without debate arguments, snippets in both
